summary: Quote and LTP on one equity: HSM's binary login waits for its K, the symbol-feed snapshot gives both frames, and an update record carrying only the changed fields is applied whole to the snapshot.

deviations.reason: The web's Fyers adapter stamps timestamp with int(time.time()), epoch seconds; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), as the desktop sends them.
The web sends oi 0 for an equity whose HSM record carried no OI (fyers_data.get('OI', 0)); a field the stream does not carry is left out, never sent as 0 (web openalgo#2376), as the desktop does.
The web's server also sends this client a richer mode's publication of the instrument, beyond the modes it holds; the desktop sends one frame per held mode.
deviations.ref: websocket_proxy/server.py zmq_listener (for m in range(1, mode + 1))
